content: {"episode_id":"ep-05012","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 based on the documented clinical indication, acknowledging that prior authorization is missing. The patient has recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea, consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, the clinical indication note states that continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to assess arrhythmic burden and guide anticoagulation management."}
